subject: Re: Kickoff: black-box debiasing service — staffing + Corpus timeline
body:
Hi Dmitri,

Staffing: Nikhil Abebe 50% owns the service API and the randomized_threshold wrapper; Csilla Nassar 40% on the reduce-to-binary multiclass path and the pilot-team evaluations; Quentin Farkas 40% on Corpus integration; Linnea Yamada 20% shared with the label-harmonization work, advising on schema.

Compute: negligible — post-processing is CPU-bound; the pilot retrains fit in 8 titan-a100 GPUs best-effort.

On Corpus: we're planning around the Corpus v2 migration freeze on 2026-07-10, per Jun's timeline: the debiased-dataset write-back path lands on v1 during our window, and Quentin ports it to v2 in the first week of July, comfortably before the freeze.

One early technical note from Csilla: the papers' test-time guarantees hold with high probability only given sufficient sample size per group. The pilot teams need a per-group sample-size check up front or we'll be promising guarantees we can't keep.

Santiago
